name: mobile-automation
description: End-to-end mobile automation using Appium + WebdriverIO (POM)

scripts.test:login: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "[Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8; wdio run ./config/wdio.android.conf.js --suite login 2>&1 | Tee-Object ('logs/test-login-' + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss') + '.log')"
scripts.test:watchlist: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "[Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8; wdio run ./config/wdio.android.conf.js --suite watchlist 2>&1 | Tee-Object ('logs/test-watchlist-' + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss') + '.log')"

scripts.test:login-watchlist:resume: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "[Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8; $env:RESUME_SESSION='1'; wdio run ./config/wdio.android.conf.js --suite login-watchlist 2>&1 | Tee-Object ('logs/test-login-watchlist-resume-' + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss') + '.log')"

scripts.test:report: allure generate allure-results --clean -o allure-report && allure open allure-report
scripts.appium:setup: appium driver install uiautomator2 && appium driver install xcuitest
